specifications.statement: Series overview states fan cooling; ordering table defines N as Normal and R as Reverse airflow. For the exact NA identity, normal is a printed option label; connector-to-connector direction is not stated on these pages. [PDF p. 2, 9]
Printed small form factor: 321.5 × 54.5 × 40 mm (12.66 × 2.14 × 1.57 in); dimension order preserved without assigning unprinted axes. [PDF p. 1]
Always-On 16.5 W programmable standby output (3.3/5 V) is a series feature; it is not an instruction to sum rail maxima. [PDF p. 1]

Figure 20 for PFE1100-12-054NA shows nominal main-output current derating dependent on AC input voltage and ambient temperature. Prose says current limitation decreases above 45°C inlet ambient or when AC input is too low, and actual V1 current limitation begins approximately 4 A above Figure 20. No graph points are digitized or transferred from the separate RA Figure 21. [PDF p. 9]

Main output V1 nominal voltage 12.0 VDC; nominal output power 1080 W and nominal output current 90.0 ADC at V1 = 12 VDC. Table general condition Ta = 0 … +45 °C unless otherwise noted; these are not current-limitation thresholds. [PDF p. 5]
Normal-airflow standby nominal ratings: 3.3 VDC, 16.5 W, 5 ADC; or 5.0 VDC, 16.5 W, 3.3 ADC. Table general condition Ta = 0 … +45 °C unless otherwise noted. [PDF p. 5]
PFE1100-12-054xA series is described as a 1100 Watt AC to DC power supply with 12 VDC main output; this class description is distinct from the nominal main-output table rating. [PDF p. 1]
Series wide input voltage range: 90–264 VAC; output derating applies at low input voltage/raised ambient temperature. [PDF p. 1, 9]

specifications.statement: Canada/United States, NAC-listed model group, 100–200 VAC input: 83.4–125 A at 45°C; 69–104 A at 60°C. These are linear derating ranges, not a constant rating at every input voltage. [PDF p. 4]
Canada/United States, NAC-listed model group, 200–240 VAC or 200–350 VDC input: 125 A at 45°C; 104 A at 60°C. [PDF p. 4]

Countries other than Canada/United States, NAC-listed model group, 100–200 VAC input: 66.5–125 A at 45°C; 66.5–104 A at 60°C. These are linear derating ranges, not a constant rating at every input voltage. [PDF p. 4]
Countries other than Canada/United States, NAC-listed model group, 200–240 VAC or 200–350 VDC input: 125 A at 45°C; 104 A at 60°C. [PDF p. 4]

For model groups explicitly including PFE1500-12-054NAC, main output V1 = 12.0 V; output derates linearly as ambient increases 45°C → 60°C and input voltage decreases 200 VAC → 100 VAC. Regional tables remain separate. [PDF p. 4]
Certificate rated AC input for listed model group including NAC: 100–240 V ~, 12–7 A, 50/60 Hz. [PDF p. 1]
Certificate rated output for listed model group including NAC: V1 12.0 Vdc, 125 A; Vsb alternatives 5 Vdc, 3.3 A / 3.3 Vdc, 5 A. [PDF p. 1]

V1 maximum output power is de-rated at different input voltages and operating ambient temperatures; certificate directs the reader to Conditions of Acceptability. It does not establish 125 A at every operating condition. [PDF p. 1]
N Normal Airflow from Output connector to Input AC socket; the exact PFE1500-12-054NAC ordering row is under that normal-airflow footnote. [PDF p. 2]
Exact PFE1500-12-054NAC ordering row: C16 AC input connector; input range 180 VDC ~ 350 VDC and 90 VAC ~ 264 VAC. These operating ranges are distinct from certificate rated-input ranges. [PDF p. 2]
Upper standard ordering group has programmable 3.3/5 V standby; lower S412 12 VSB models are separate and excluded from this NAC statement. [PDF p. 2]

specifications.statement: Dimension (L × W × H): 185 × 73.5 × 39 mm; 7.28 × 2.89 × 1.53 inch. These are page-1 specifications, not the disputed page-2 drawing. [PDF p. 1]
Working temperature: 0°C to 55°C. [PDF p. 1]
Input specifications: 90–264 VAC, 47–63 Hz; input current 115 VAC @ 8 A, 230 VAC @ 4 A. Output rating is separately scoped to 100–240 V input. [PDF p. 1]
Output rating at 100–240 V input: +12 V, minimum 1.0 A and maximum 45.8 A; +12 Vsb, minimum 0.0 A and maximum 2.1 A. Rail maxima are separate; no simultaneous summed total is inferred. [PDF p. 1]
Redundant power supply module based on CRPS 2.0; total power capacity up to 550 Watts. [PDF p. 1]
